meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 它把仓库里成堆的 GitHub issue 按同一个架构根因归成少数几个 plan-master,用固定话术把子 issue 作为症状重定向关闭,再让你用一个 PR 一次性关闭整簇。
howto.when: 当仓库积压了 20 多个 open issue、你要求 triage / 聚类 / 去重 / 做路线图,或有新 bug 想归入已有计划时触发。

say.text: 把当前仓库的 open issue 按根因聚成几个 plan-master
say.note: 会先读完全部 issue 正文与评论再聚类

say.text: 这个新 bug 属于哪个已有计划?归进去并关掉它
say.note: 在对应 master 上追加 Round N 评论

say.text: 给 plan-02 打包一个 PR,关闭它名下所有子 issue
say.note: PR 合并后子 issue 自动关闭

howto.what_en: It clusters a repo's GitHub issues by shared root cause into a few plan-master issues, closes each child with a standard redirect comment, and bundles one PR that closes a whole cluster atomically.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a tracker has 20+ open issues, when you ask to triage, cluster or dedupe issues or build a roadmap, or when a new bug should join an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster this repo's open issues by root cause into plan masters
say_en.note: It reads every body and comment first

say_en.text: Does this new bug belong to an existing plan? Route and close it
say_en.note: Adds a Round N comment to that master

say_en.text: Bundle a PR for plan-02 that closes all its children
